email.description: User's valid email to use for registration.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
This is a User Administration C3 type used to allow a user to execute sign-up using a token which can be embedded
in a link in an invitation email.

For example, this is how it is used in IDS:

Admin:
1. Invokes {@link UserRegistration.start} to obtain a registration token
2. Constructs invitation email which includes a link that points new user to the registration page.
   The link contains the token string as part of the URL.
New user:
1. Clicks the invitation link
2. User gets in to a 'public' page that will execute execute a {@link UserRegistration.validateToken}
   action with the token. This call return the corresponding UserRegistration object or null.
3. If a UserRegistration object is returned (valid token) then the page will invoke the {@link UserRegistration.complete}
   which will:
   - create the user
   - set password
   - add user to the registered group(s)
name: UserRegistration
